item.title: NAPTIP intercepts 10 suspected trafficked minors in Taraba
item.description: The Taraba State Command of the National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons, NAPTIP, has intercepted a suspected human trafficker and rescued 10 minors in Jalingo. item.title: 2027: Labour Party already in coalition – Gov Otti
